rationale: The stock gapped up ~11% on strong earnings and has already made a wide intraday range ($25.02–$29.16), with price now sitting at 79% of that range but below the 9-EMA ($28.69) and showing very low-volume, nearly flat 1-minute candles — suggesting momentum has stalled and the tape is indecisive. The spread is manageable but the stock is extended from any clean technical level, making both a long (chasing into a faded high) and a short (fighting a strong earnings catalyst with positive market backdrop) unattractive risk/reward propositions at this moment.
